invariants.rationale: The result of updateLocation should never be null as it is constructed from HoodieListData.eager.
writeStatuses is passed as a parameter and is expected to be non-null, otherwise collectAsList() would throw.
context is used in the delegated call, so must be non-null.
hoodieTable is passed to the underlying method; null would cause a failure.
The returned object is constructed using HoodieListData.eager, which returns a HoodieData.
